outputs.explanation: Panel A contains blots plus three bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fractions) showing band intensity quantification as mean ± SD (N=4). These are bar charts of averaged data, but only bars with error bars are shown — no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the 4 replicates) are overlaid.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot showing HMGB1 detection across differently purified mitochondrial/cytosolic/nuclear fractions; it contains no quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection assay results (bands only, no plotted averages), so the check does not apply.
